n08c8a7b56a.headline: Israel: Intel plans largest investment in years
n08c8a7b56a.summary: Intel announced plans to expand its activities in Israel with a new plant in Kiryat Gat, involving investments up to $11 billion.
n08c8a7b56a.why: Intel is a major global semiconductor manufacturer, and large investments in production capacity can impact the technology supply chain and regional economies.

impacts.name: Intel
impacts.why: Intel's large investment signals growth and expansion in production capacity.

n08c8a7b56a.why_moved: Intel's announcement of a major $11 billion investment in Israel signals expansion in semiconductor manufacturing, which can boost investor confidence and regional economic growth.

nb95aaf10bc.headline: Minimum wage decree in northern border was not clear: Francisco García
nb95aaf10bc.summary: The governor of Tamaulipas, Mexico, stated that the recent minimum wage decree for the northern border is unclear and that maquiladora companies threatening to leave are open to dialogue.
nb95aaf10bc.why: Minimum wage policies affect labor costs and investment decisions in Mexico's important manufacturing border region.
